doc: The battle fixtures: GATO's fight (fx_gato_*), Guardia Forest's fights (fx_forest_*), the Cathedral's three-member party (fx_party3_*) -- recipes from power-on, plus the owner's documented WRAM pokes for the synthetic variants (env PEEK_POKE on a 0-frame peek of the base recipe).

fixtures.doc: The suite's GATO seed: the last frame before GATO's song sequence (f145 after his last box). The play clock $0400-$0405 is set to the capture's (8:28, which the X menu's TIME prints and the menu checks pin); everything else is the recipe's.
